title: Attic spaces.
officialText:
Enclosed attics and enclosed rafter spaces formed where ceilings are applied directly to the underside of roof
framing members shall have cross ventilation for each separate space by ventilating openings protected against the entrance of
rain and snow. Blocking and bridging shall be arranged so as not to interfere with the movement of air. A min imum of 1 inch (25
mm) of airspace shall be provided between the insulation and the roof sheathing. The net free ventilating area shall not be less
than 1/150 of the area of the space ventilated, with 50 percent of the required ventilating area provided by ventilators located in
the upper portion of the space to be ventilated at least 3 feet (914 mm) above eave or cornice vents with the balance of the
required ventilation provided by eave or cornice vents.
